text:
mia: Quick heads-up — we hit a perf regression in the Dedicated build on sequence-length 8k, likely from the recent batching change. Looks like a 15-20% P95 latency bump.
derek: Oof. Which pilot customers will notice?
mia: BetaRetail + internal load tests. BetaRetail’s SLA target might fail under peak.
nina: Propose a scoped cut for v1: remove advanced batching heuristics and ship with conservative batch size defaults. Keep KV cache and model pinning.
omar: Agreed. Also suggest delaying per-tenant autoscaling until v1.1. Low priority for initial pilots.
product-bot: Planning sync scheduled: scope-triage today 11:00 PT. Invite sent to @eng-runtime @customer-success.
derek: If we cut batching heuristics, we should document expected cost impact and a rollback path. Nina, can you draft the customer note for BetaRetail?
nina: On it — will include metrics, timeline, and mitigations.
mia: Locking proposed cutlist at 10:45 unless objections. Keep it tight so CS can notify pilots. :white_check_mark:
derek: No objections from infra; we'll run targeted perf canaries on the conservative build today.
omar: I'll prep the update for the milestone board and shift GA window by one week as a soft buffer.
mia: Thanks — we'll aim to finalize after the canary results.
